{{Quote|The Crisis Response Unit ambushed us! I got away. Only me.|Igro|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Igro''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] criminal who was imprisoned in [[Belsavis prison]] until freed by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[invasion of Belsavis]] in the [[Galactic War]]. Recruited by the Empire, Igro was among a group of criminals sent to secure the [[Carbonite Prisoner Storage]] in the [[Minimum Security Section]], but the [[Crisis Response Unit]] wiped out the group with only Igro escaping. He fled back to the [[Imperial Lodgement]] and reported the failure to the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Medechas]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Igro appears in a cutscene in the Imperial mission "The Carbon Gallery" on Belsavis in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
